en: Colorized vintage view of a landscaped square with trees, benches, and people walking along a paved promenade in front of a large pavilion-like building with multiple pitched roofs and decorative finials. The caption at the bottom reads "PRAÇA DE SERPA PINTO." Mountains are visible in the distant background, and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century picture postcard.
